files.patch: @@ -928,0 +928,12 @@ + + When preview features are enabled, JVMTI may observe both identity and value objects. + JVMTI treats both kinds of objects in the same manner as JNI. Agents can use the JNI + HasIdentity + function to determine whether a JNI object reference denotes an object with identity. + JNI functions whose semantics depend on identity, including + IsSameObject + and + NewWeakGlobalRef, + specify the JNI behavior for value objects.
